summary: Revolution Medicines, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into four lease agreements for approximately 672,000 rentable square feet at four buildings in Redwood City, California, for use as its new headquarters. The leases have staggered commencements from September 2027 through September 2028, initial terms to September 2042 with extension options, aggregate base rent starting at $2.7 million per month rising 3% annually, rent abatement of about $23.1 million, tenant improvement allowances up to $115.9 million plus optional $40.3 million, and effectiveness subject to landlord property acquisition by December 31, 2026, with termination rights if closing fails. This is an ordinary real estate lease, not a special situation; routine financing obligation under Item 2.03 as it creates a material direct financial obligation. No special-situation angle; typical for a company securing corporate headquarters.
